info.title: ErvisioDrive API
info.description: Versioned Bearer API. Every request rechecks the token, whitelist, current owner role, resource restrictions and content ACL. Tokens cannot delegate scopes, resources or lifetimes beyond their own. Workspace roles are not inferred from Cognito groups. See docs/API.md for examples and security semantics.

url.description: Browser session URL; API clients should use /files/{id}/download.

parent.description: Slug of the containing folder; null at the top level.

ancestors.description: Slugs of every containing folder, outermost first.

token.description: Public download capability. Treat as a secret.

nextCursor.description: Pass this value as cursor; null marks the last page.

member.description: Usage and quota of the token owner.

folder.description: A custom folder slug, or all for automatic MIME categories. A restricted token must allow every resulting destination.
Existing custom slug or images/videos/audio/documents/other; all detects MIME.

expiresAt.description: Future UTC instant, or null to clear expiry.

content.description: UTF-8 text, at most 2 MiB after encoding.

grant.description: Provide email or userId of an existing whitelisted account; the content owner or an administrator must perform this operation.

password.description: Optional; at most 72 UTF-8 bytes, not characters. Never put it in a query string.

parent.description: Slug of a readable folder to create this one inside, at most 32 levels deep. Restricted tokens may only create folders inside one they allow.
Moves the folder and its subfolders inside this folder; null moves it to the top level. A folder cannot move into itself or its own subfolders.

folder.description: Destination folder slug, or all for the automatic category.

success.description: false when at least one file failed; see data.

issueInvitation.description: true additionally requires members:invite; otherwise no invitation is issued.

uploadMaxMb.description: Per-file limit in MiB. null uses UPLOAD_MAX_MB; 0 is unlimited.

storageQuotaGb.description: Workspace quota in GiB. null uses STORAGE_QUOTA_GB; 0 is unlimited.

userQuotaGb.description: Default quota per member in GiB; 0 is unlimited.

ownerId.description: Defaults to self; another owner requires tokens:manage:any.

x-permission-catalog.tokens:manage:any: Manage API tokens belonging to other accounts
